annotations.title: Validate recipients and compile an e-mail without sending it

description: Runs the full validation and Markdown-to-HTML compilation of an e-mail without sending anything: checks every recipient address and the subject, compiles the body and returns the recipient list and the compiled size, with status 'preview_compiled'. Use it before agent_send_email when an agent is unsure of an address list built from scraped or user-typed data, to show a human what will go out for approval, or to keep alerts under a size budget. Do not use it to deliver a message, since nothing leaves the server, and do not treat a passing preview as proof that a mailbox exists: only the address syntax is checked. Read-only and idempotent: the same input always gives the same result apart from the generated preview id. Costs 0.005 USDC per call, paid with x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453), a B2B X-API-Key or a Wafermap marketplace signature; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header instead of an exception, and every failure is a JSON body with 'error', so an agent loop never breaks on a thrown error.

from.description: Sender as 'Name <address>'. Defaults to the server's verified sender; a custom address only works on a domain verified with the mail provider.

html.description: Ready HTML body, sent as is with no compilation. Use only when you already hold rendered HTML.

markdown.description: Body in Markdown, compiled at the edge into a responsive HTML e-mail: headings, bold, italics, links, paragraphs and line breaks are supported. Preferred body field for agents. Ignored when 'html' is given.

replyTo.description: Address that replies should go to, such as the human owner of the agent.

text.description: Plain-text body, used as the text part and, when neither markdown nor html is given, compiled to HTML.

to.description: Recipient address or addresses, for example 'ops@example.com' or ['a@example.com', 'b@example.com']. Every address is syntax-checked; one invalid address rejects the whole call with HTTP 400 and the offending value in 'error'.

oneOf.description: One address, or several separated by commas.

name: agent_preview_email

outputSchema.description: Result of the dispatch or preview. On failure only 'success' false and 'error' are present.

error.description: Failure reason, present only on a rejected call, such as an invalid recipient or a missing subject (HTTP 400).

messageId.description: Provider message id when the provider accepted the message; otherwise a locally generated id starting with 'msg_x402_' or, for a preview, 'preview_x402_'.

provider.description: 'resend-edge-live' means the mail provider accepted the message for delivery and 'messageId' is its id. 'edge-markdown-compiler' means a preview. 'edge-transactional-gateway' means the message was validated and compiled but not accepted by a mail provider, so do not tell a human it was delivered.

recipientCount.description: Number of recipients after splitting and validation.

renderedHtmlBytes.description: Size of the compiled HTML body in bytes, useful to keep alerts small.

status.description: 'preview_compiled' for a dry run; 'dispatched' otherwise. Check 'provider' to know whether a mail provider accepted it.

success.description: True when the message passed validation and was compiled or handed off.

title: Validate recipients and compile an e-mail without sending it
